title: The Orbital *Compute*
dek: Google confirmed four AI chips are alive in orbit. Microsoft gave every enterprise agent its own email address. The datacenter containment perimeter is breaking on every vector at once.

stories.label: Trillium TPUs now in low Earth orbit after SpaceX rideshare launch Oct 1
stories.headline: Google's Project Suncatcher confirmed contact. AI inference hardware is in orbit.

stories.label: dense TOPS of edge inference on SiMa's next chip (H1 2028), no cloud required
stories.headline: SiMa.ai raised $150M to build AI silicon for robots that never need a cloud connection.

stories.short: Microsoft agents get own email address
stories.label: existing Copilot seats getting agents with their own Entra identity and email address
stories.headline: Microsoft gave every enterprise AI agent its own email address. That is the governance story.

stories.label: valuation jump in 13 months: $2B to reportedly $10B for GPS-denied robotics
stories.headline: FieldAI is reportedly seeking $700M at $10B. A year ago it was worth $2B.

stories.short: Apple restricts AI agent disk access
stories.headline: Apple restricts AI agent disk access as Microsoft expands agent identity. Opposite answers to the same authorization question.

still_signal: The capital committed this week in orbit, edge silicon, and GPS-denied terrain is solving a 2026 infrastructure bottleneck. The governance responses from Apple and Microsoft are solving a 2025 authorization problem. The gap between those timescales is where the next incidents occur.
